video_title: Chris Webber has ALWAYS been a Jalen Brunson fan 🗣️ ‘HE’S A BUCKET-GETTER!' | The Rich Eisen Show

quotes.speaker: Chris Webber
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Webber critiques the Spurs' Game 4 performance against the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: That was probably the dumbest game and I like to say most arrogant game that's ever been played.
quotes.quote: I love Barkley so much and a lot of times we share the same opinion in talking to coaches and others. That was probably the dumbest game and I like to say most arrogant game that's ever been played. With the stakes this high, you have to give credit to New York for not falling for it or feeling sorry or looking forward to Game 5. The heart that it took to come back in that game is incredible.

quotes.speaker: Chris Webber
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Webber emphasizes on-court play over analytics for the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: It shows how you really have to have real on-the-court feel and not just analytics.
quotes.quote: It shows how you really have to have real on-the-court feel and not just analytics because I don't think analytics would tell you to shoot the ball eight times in a row if you made it seven times in a row, let alone you miss and taking shots early in the shot clock.

quotes.speaker: Chris Webber
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Webber praises Stephen Curry's three-point shooting and finishing ability
quotes.excerpt: Stephen Curry is the best three-point shooter we've ever seen and he's one of the best finishers.
quotes.quote: Stephen Curry is the best three-point shooter we've ever seen and he's one of the best finishers. He never gets credit for that because as soon as you think that you deny him, he goes back door and he makes a layup. That's the brilliance of him shooting threes. He's not just a specialist.

quotes.speaker: Chris Webber
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Webber discusses Chet Holmgren's unique value to the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Chet Holmgren has a unique body type, he can play defense, and I'm not looking for him to score 30.
quotes.quote: I've always said I'm not trading Chet Holmgren. Chet Holmgren has a unique body type, he can play defense, and I'm not looking for him to score 30 in Game 7. The only reason why people I think depended on him to do that was because he had players out and he was the next guy up.

quotes.speaker: Chris Webber
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Webber praises Jalen Brunson's work ethic and skill level
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson is not a specialist, he's a bucket-getter.
quotes.quote: I've always been a Jalen Brunson fan. Ever since I watched Jalen, I knew he was a dog. To me, that's the number one trait you have to have. There are many skilled individuals, but do you have the work ethic? Can you be long-suffering? Can you not listen to what people say? Jalen Brunson is not a specialist, he's a bucket-getter.
